android_arm64_cli.meaning: Official LiteRT-LM v0.9.0 Android arm64 CLI release asset is cached and ABI-identified; this is the current concrete edge runtime artifact for pre-GPU dependency preparation.

android_ndk.meaning: Approved NDK r28b archive is cached and a tiny AArch64 compile probe passed; this proves the toolchain, not LiteRT-LM model execution.

maven_aar.meaning: Official Maven AAR and direct POM dependencies are cached for future Android API integration, but this report explicitly does not claim a transitive Gradle closure or app build.

decision.rationale: The current first-release dependency-prep scope has no selected Android app/Gradle deliverable. The official Android arm64 CLI is the concrete side-runtime artifact available now; Maven AAR is prepared only as an integration cache. Claiming Gradle/App closure as done would be false, and downloading a full Gradle graph now would expand product packaging scope.

future_product_classification.android_gradle_app_or_aar_api_package: future packaging/integration artifact; required only after root selects Android AAR/App as a concrete deliverable or acceptance lane
required_future_work_if_selected: Resolve full transitive Gradle dependencies under an isolated prefix.
Record licenses, hashes, and source URLs for the complete Gradle graph.
Run an offline Gradle/AAR or minimal Android compile/link canary without host installs.
Later run device/emulator and model-forward memory/latency evidence when generated E2B artifacts exist.

not_claimed: No Gradle transitive dependency closure is complete.
No Android app/AAR build canary was run.
No Android device/emulator execution was run.
No LiteRT-LM model forward or generated E2B artifact is available in this pre-GPU slice.
No new Android SDK terms, host installs, paid services, or GPU work were used.
question: Whether before-GPU/offline-prep must complete Android Gradle/App transitive closure, or whether the official Android arm64 CLI plus cached Maven AAR metadata is enough for current first-release dependency preparation.

scope_basis.evidence: Delivery asks for an E2B edge package and offline E2B operation evidence; it does not specify an Android app UI or Gradle project as the current first-release artifact.
Project scope is API, single-card package, and E2B edge package; final acceptance later requires side/runtime measurements, not a pre-GPU Android app build.
offline-prep:03 covers required build dependencies before GPU, while future mobile packages and generated quant artifacts remain release outputs after training/conversion.
